output_text: Always structure your Ansible content into roles and collections. Role Scoping: Each role or module must focus on a single, well-defined task. Create dedicated `_info`/`_facts` modules/tasks for information gathering. Enforce strict YAML formatting. File Start: All YAML files must begin with `---`. Indentation: Use two spaces for indentation, never tabs. Quote strings only when necessary; prefer single quotes; use double quotes for escaping or multi-line strings. Use exactly one space after colons. Always use structured map style, not `key=value`. Use `true`/`false`. Use `snake_case`; prefix roles with the collection namespace. Write idempotent tasks; prefer declarative modules over `command`/`shell`. Always use `atomic_move` (implicitly via `copy`, `template` modules) for file modifications.
